title: Coordinate
description: Geographic coordinate point with latitude, longitude, place name, and elevation. Used for mapping, GPS tracking, location services, and geographic data storage.

id.description: Unique identifier for the coordinate record

latitude.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees (-90 to 90)

longitude.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees (-180 to 180)

place.description: Name of the place or location at these coordinates

elevation.description: Elevation above sea level in meters
